thread:
Alex: Getting paged — seeing a spike of 5xx from inference-west; alerts show ~7% failing over the last 5m, request volume normal. p50 latency hasn't moved much. I'm running quick checks, but heads-up I need to step out in ~10m.

incident-bot: Pager received: INFR-2026 (P1) — 5xx rate >5% (inference-west). Docs: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INFR-2026

Priya: On it. Alex, can you paste the alert query? I want to check if errors are spread across models or concentrated.

Alex: Alerting query: `sum(rate(inference_errors_total{region="west"}[5m])) by (model)` -> most of the 5xx are from model=llm-xlarge-v1. Quick log sample shows `KV cache miss -> downstream gpu OOM` in a few traces.

Marco: Noted. I'll start prep for a customer impact note if this looks like degradation across keys. Which customers hit this the most?

Jing: I can flip a fallback route to model=llm-xlarge-quant-lite for a subset while we triage. That's lower accuracy but much lower memory. Recommend canary 5% traffic first. Command I use: ```routerctl set-route --service inference --from region=west --to model=llm-xlarge-quant-lite --percent 5 --reason "fallback for 5xx spike"```

Priya: Good idea. Before that, quick checks: 1) evict KV cache for model shard; 2) check pod memory RSS and GPU mem; 3) confirm there isn't a recent model rollout. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-fallback and https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-rollbacks

Alex: I kicked off `kubectl top pods -n inference | grep llm-xlarge` — a couple pods show GPU mem at 98%. Also saw a restart on pod inference-rt-7f9a yesterday around 02:12Z.

Priya: Ok, plan: A) start a small fallback canary (Jing) to reduce immediate customer errors; B) evict KV cache for affected shard (me); C) if errors don't drop in 3m, scale down model shard and restart its pods gracefully. Marco, can you prepare a short impact blurb for customers? Keep it minimal: what, who affected, mitigation, ETA.

Marco: Yep. Drafting: "We're seeing increased 5xx errors for requests routed to model llm-xlarge-v1 in west. We've routed 5% of traffic to a fallback model to mitigate immediate failures while we stabilize. Some customers may see lower output fidelity. We'll update within 30 minutes with progress." Will post to #customer-status and send to oncall-notify if impact >10% traffic.

Jing: Canary started: `routerctl` returned OK, id=canary-3822. Monitoring logs for errors from that path.

Priya: Evicting KV cache for shard-3: ```curl -X POST https://internal-api/cache/evict -d '{"model":"llm-xlarge-v1","shard":"3"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN'``` Waiting for responses.

incident-bot: Action logged: KV cache evict requested by Priya. Ticket: RUN-9302.

Priya: Cache eviction returns success. Watching error rate... 2m in: 5xx dropped from 7% -> 3.1%. Good sign.

Alex: Thanks team — need to leave now. Warm takeover: Priya will be primary, Marco secondary. Notes for handover: primary should watch 5xx (<1% goal), check `gpu_mem_used` per pod, verify no recent model rollouts in the last 24h (`/releases`), and confirm canary stability for 15m before removing fallback. Runbook quicklinks I used: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-fallback (evict steps), https://redwood.internal/runbooks/graceful-restart (kubectl restart guidance) and `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-llm-xlarge -n prod --to-revision=3` if we need rollback.

Priya: Taking primary now. Coverage: primary=Priya (until 15:00Z), secondary=Marco. If I need an escalation, ping @Jing or escalate to SRE oncall. I'll post a short status update every 10m.

Marco: Ack. I'll keep the customer blurb updated and stand by to widen fallback if we see any uplift in errors.

incident-bot: Incident INFR-2026 status: mitigated -> partial (errors reduced to 3.1%). Next review in 10m.

Alex: Thanks all; leaving notes in the incident ticket with commands run and the canary id. Priya — I added `evict` output and `kubectl top` snapshot to the ticket.

Priya: Got it. Team, quick checklist for whoever picks this up later: - primary/secondary assignment in the incident ticket - canary id (canary-3822) and when it was started - KV eviction ticket RUN-9302 - thresholds to clear: 5xx <1% and canary stable for 15m - rollback command (if needed) `kubectl rollout undo ...` - runbook links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-fallback, https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-rollbacks, https://redwood.internal/runbooks/customer-notify

Marco: Adding note: Affected customers list saved to ticket (cust-ids: 1124, 2201, 3309). Will coordinate PMs if any of those report anomalies.

Priya: Closing loop for now — will update when we're green or if things worsen. :thumbsup:
